items.title: Oscar "Chicken" Henry Interview, 1959-07-11
items.q: He played trumpet. We had George McCullum, George Feuerbos

ctx.x: Did Louis DeMaine ever play his trumpet?
He played trumpet. We had George McCullum, George Feuerbos, Big Hater Eddie Johnson with Little World Lines. Little, that little fella play saxophone. Oh shit. Was Handy in that?
No, Handy wasn't in there. Handy wasn't in there.
